description: This file defines a helper class for logging, providing static methods to log messages at various levels and manage LogNode chaining. It primarily wraps Android's native Log utility for project-specific logging purposes.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: Helper class providing static methods for logging at various levels, managing LogNode chains, and abstracting Android's native Log functionality.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode chain to a specified node.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Delegates a log message with given priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable to the chain.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE level, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG level, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO level, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN level, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR level, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT level, with optional Throwable.
